$ corvex gate ack --help

--- stdout ---
Record that you read a piece of evidence, now, and leave the gate open.

Why a verb and not a flag on approve: `--ack` at approve time can only say "I read it and decided in the same breath". This says only the first half, it persists, and a later `corvex gate approve` accepts it — so reading on Monday and deciding on Tuesday is expressible. The lock does not loosen: every required item still has to be acknowledged.

The labels come from `corvex gate show`. A label the gate does not carry is refused.

Usage:
  corvex gate ack <run-id> [flags]

Flags:
      --ack stringArray   mark one piece of evidence as read, by label (repeatable)
  -h, --help              help for ack
      --step string       step id, when more than one gate is waiting on the run

Global Flags:
      --no-color   Disable color output
  -q, --quiet      Suppress per-task progress; print only failures/errors and the final summary

--- stderr ---
(empty)

--- error ---
(nil)
